recommended_phases.title: Phase 1 — Deduplicate leave.service.ts date helpers
recommended_phases.rationale: Delete private periodContaining/startOfUtcDay/addMonths, import all three from ../../shared/date, update call sites (this.periodContaining -> periodContaining, this.startOfUtcDay -> startOfUtcDay). No new module dependency (shared-date already allowed).

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2 — Deduplicate balance.service.ts addMonths
recommended_phases.rationale: Delete private addMonths, add addMonths to existing ../../shared/date import, update call site (this.addMonths -> addMonths).

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3 — Add deduplication regression test
recommended_phases.rationale: Pin shared helpers behave identically for a period boundary case under a non-UTC timezone (TZ=Asia/Riyadh) so a future private-copy drift is caught.

app_notes: This is a pure refactor (deletion + import) with no behaviour change and no new API surface. The only application-layer change is that leave and balance services now consume the canonical shared-date helpers instead of private copies. No new service methods, no new modules, no new dependency edges beyond the already-allowed leave->shared-date and balance->shared-date. The shared-date module remains the single owner of startOfUtcDay, addMonths, and periodContaining. Do not alter the getUTC* arithmetic in startOfUtcDay (load-bearing against node-pg local-midnight parsing; src/shared/db/connection.ts pins DATE parsing to UTC).
auth_contract: request.user: { id: string; role: EmployeeRole }; EmployeeRole = 'employee' | 'manager' | 'admin'; JWT bearer verified by auth middleware populating request.user; RBAC enforced by route-level guard, never inline.
error_response_contract: errors return { error: string; code: string }; validation failure -> HTTP 400; authentication failure -> 401; authorization failure -> 403; not found -> 404.
